note: Attacker-controlled bytes are treated as a C string after basic length and NUL checks.
The first byte selects the command; the remaining bytes become the flow-mod text passed to the parser.

code: error = parse_ofp_flow_mod_str(&fm, input, NULL, NULL, command, &usable_protocols);
note: The parser allocates and populates fm.ofpacts and fm.match from the attacker-controlled flow string.
On the success path, the temporary minimatch is destroyed once here after encoding.
The same minimatch is destroyed a second time in the helper after ofputil_encode_flow_mod returns, causing a heap double-free in minimatch_destroy.
The sink is the second free of already-freed heap-backed fields inside the minimatch object.
